### Scene 1: Credit Score Tier Breakdown
**(00:00-00:07):** A woman sits on the floor with her back resting against a sofa, working on a laptop placed on a small low table next to a water bottle. In the foreground, a large informational graphic overlay covers most of the frame, detailing what different credit score ranges provide. The scene is captured in a single continuous shot with indoor natural/ambient lighting.
- **Spoken:** none
- **Delivery:** none
- **On-screen text:** 
  - "What your CREDIT SCORE actually gets you in 2026"
  - "300-579 | Most lenders won't touch you. Mortgage denied. Car loans at 20%+. Apartments need a guarantor. Business funding almost impossible."
  - "580-669 | Doors start opening but at a cost. FHA mortgage possible. Car loans still expensive at 12-18%. Basic credit cards only. Business funding very limited."
  - "670-739 | Things get easier. Conventional mortgage approved. Car loans drop to 7-12%. Rewards cards available. Business funding options opening up."
  - "740-799 | Lenders compete for you. Strong mortgage rates. Car loans at 4-7%. Premium cards, high limits. Real business capital at rates that make sense."
  - "800+ | You set the terms. Best mortgage rates available. Car loans under 4%. Elite cards, highest limits. Business funding at maximum leverage."

---

### Audio
- **First 1-2 seconds:** Electronic synth beats and vocal track starting abruptly ("Walk in on a dream...").
- **Overall:** Electronic pop/dance background music with female vocals; no spoken voiceover.

---

### Summary
- Displays a financial informational graphic categorizing credit score brackets from 300 to 800+.
- Breaks down loan approval odds, interest rate expectations, and credit limits for mortgages, auto loans, and business funding per tier.
- Features a static background visual of an individual working on a laptop at home accompanied by a pop track.
